lines.en: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
lines.cn: 我刚刚搬到了 Bridge Street 上的一栋房子里。

lines.en: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.
lines.cn: 昨天，一个乞丐敲了我的门。

lines.en: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
lines.cn: 他请我吃了一顿饭，还喝了一杯啤酒。

lines.en: the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
lines.cn: 那个乞丐倒立着，同时还在唱歌。

lines.en: He ate the food and drank the beer.
Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.
lines.cn: 然后他把一块奶酪放进口袋里，就离开了。

lines.en: Later a neighbour told me about him.
lines.cn: 后来，一位邻居跟我讲起了他的情况。
他的名字叫珀西·巴顿斯（Percy Buttons）。

lines.en: He calls at every house in the street once a month
lines.cn: 他每个月会去街道上的每一户人家拜访一次。

lines.en: and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer.
lines.cn: 并且总是要求吃一顿饭和喝一杯啤酒。
